requested_scope: Build and verify one scoped development environment, not an intelligence benchmark

criteria.rationale: Owner two-store/selective inquiry requirement traced through ten ENV requirements to actual checks.
Participant snapshot, broker read allowlist and private scorer physically separated; deployment caveat explicit.
One standard-library broker, immutable stores and offline scorer; no LLM, model service or per-concept deployment.
Constructed origins, external corpus scope, duplicate lineage and conditional diagnostic classes explicit; no real biological claim.
Finite frozen evidence, typed/page/body limits and HTTP retry/failure accounting checked; full model/energy accounting deferred.
Unknowns/future/path attempts fail, conflicting retries rejected, committed response recovery and final closure exercised.
Baseline corpus hash preserved; world coefficients explicitly engineering assumptions; owner request drives noise construction.
Actual HTTP scripted fixture and snapshot checks recorded; no human/EDI superiority or ecological fidelity claim.

findings.description: Ecological calibration, unseen-world difficulty, human/EDI use and comparative advantage are untested.
Independent participant filesystem/container isolation and hostile multi-tenant deployment are not demonstrated.

changes: Added two public evidence stores and private evaluator snapshot.
Added rationale-preserving inquiry, idempotency, closure and offline outcome scoring.
Added same-target biochemical/needle distractions and explicit diagnostic-only labels.
Preserved original real corpus and attributed external excerpts.
next_step: Use the public client for an isolated development participant; define varied independent qualification worlds and matched baselines before competitive claims.
